title: Bananas Are Berries, But Strawberries Aren’t 🍌 #Shorts
script: Here is a surprising botany fact: bananas qualify as berries, while strawberries do not. In botanical terms, a berry develops from a single flower with one ovary and usually has seeds embedded inside the flesh. Bananas fit that structure. Strawberries form differently, with their seed-like fruits sitting on the outside. Everyday food names and scientific classifications can be very different.

scenes.sub: It develops from one flower and one ovary.
Their tiny outside pieces are individual fruits.
